title: Resort Lodging Terms of Payment: Deposit Due Date and Balance Due Date
content:
A Resort Lodging reservation becomes firm only once the deposit has cleared.

**A clause no longer in force.** That the deposit is the unit type's share of the room rate for the whole stay, worked out on the rate after every reduction and rounded to the cent, has been superseded by the current basis on which a deposit is worked out and is no longer in force.

## The deposit due date

The deposit is taken no later than the unit type's deposit period counted in calendar days from the day the unit was put on hold. Calendar days are counted forward from the anchor date, the anchor date itself counting as day zero, every day of the week counting alike, and a calendar day is never mixed with a full 24-hour period; where the resulting boundary falls on a date that does not exist in the target month, the last day of that month is used.

The anchor is the day the unit was put on hold as the collective's own reservation record shows it, not the day the household says it called. The comparison is not-later-than, and the boundary day itself satisfies it.

| Element | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| Anchor event | the unit was put on hold |
| Authority for the anchor | the collective's reservation record, read before the deposit is taken |
| Counting | calendar days forward, the anchor date counting as day zero |
| Direction | not later than the boundary day |
| The boundary day itself | satisfies the period |

### Two hypothetical dates on a unit type whose deposit period is 3 calendar days

A unit put on hold on the 12th of January makes the 12th day zero, so the boundary day is the 15th of January. A deposit clearing on the 15th of January is taken not later than the boundary day and satisfies the period. A deposit clearing on the 16th of January falls after the boundary day and does not.

## When a deposit may be taken at all

A deposit is taken only while the reservation stands on hold, awaiting its deposit, or firm, as the reservation record shows the standing before the deposit is taken.

## What follows

A hold whose deposit has not cleared by the due date is released and the unit returns to the shop window; the household is told before the unit goes rather than after.

The rest of the room rate falls due the unit type's balance period before arrival, and a reservation whose balance is not settled by then is treated as a cancellation on the terms that apply on that date.

superseded_clauses: The deposit is the unit type's share of the room rate for the whole stay, worked out on the rate after every reduction and rounded to the cent.
